method.previousTopics: Compare exact paths, regular-file status and raw SHA-256 to the actual pre-retry baseline for all seven prior topics.
method.backend: Compare all 85 pre-existing GD/text runtime sources; allow only the new retry-project-runtime.gd helper.
method.trackedHistory: Read every distinct HEAD docs/test-results Git blob with git cat-file --batch, SHA-256 raw bytes, compare every current regular file. HEAD must match the pre-retry baseline.
method.currentDocs: List current documentation paths changed since the baseline separately; intended current-guide updates are outside preservation claims.
method.tupleDigest: SHA-256 of sorted compact UTF-8 JSON lines [path,gitMode,gitBlobId,gitBlobSha256,currentSha256,regularFile].
